result.brief: 提出免训练的自回归视频主体定制方法，通过持久 KV 缓存锚帧、漂移自适应值放大与锚对比引导，实现长视频身份一致且运动不衰减。
result.reason: Training-free subject customization for autoregressive video generation via KV-cache anchors, drift-adaptive amplification and contrast guidance; directly serves autoregressive video generation and long-video controllability.
